description_en: Tags can mark resources, allowing enterprises or individuals to categorize templates of the same type for easier search and resource aggregation. If a template is no longer applicable to its currently bound tags, you can unbind the tags from the template. You can delete a single tag or delete tags in batches
description_zh: 标签可以标记资源，允许企业或个人将同类型的模板进行资源归类，便于搜索和资源聚合。如果模板不再适用于当前已绑定的标签，可以从模板中解绑标签。您可以删除单个标签，也可以批量删除标签
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi untag-resources --resource-type TEMPLATE --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to TEMPLATE by default
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The region ID. Set the value to cn-hangzhou by default.
For more region IDs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419270.html
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID，默认填写cn-hangzhou。
更多地域ID请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419270.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete all tags under the template. Valid values:

true: yes.
false: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否删除该模板下的所有标签。取值：

true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en: The product name. Default value: dysms
parameters.name: prod_code

parameters.help_en: The tag key. You can add no more than 20 tags at a time
parameters.help_zh: 标签键。单次添加的标签数量不超过20
parameters.name: tag_key

parameters.help_en: The SMS template code. The number of codes cannot exceed 20
parameters.help_zh: 短信模板Code。数量不能超过20条
parameters.name: resource_id

Code.description_en:
The request status code. Valid values:

OK: The request was successful.
For other error codes, see [Error code list]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。取值：

OK：代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）

Data.description_en:
The execution result of deleting the tag. Valid values:

true: success.

false: failure
Data.description_zh:
删除标签的执行结果。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
